principle: Work is ordered by release leverage. A task that cannot change the next manufacturing/design-definition decision is deferred, not deleted.
current_release_target: Close one manufacturer-grade P007 exemplar, computed EBOM/parts metadata, then batch remaining production definition.

priority_bands.title: Protect frozen mechanical design
priority_bands.policy: Do not reopen geometry or spend time optimizing the large structural margin without contrary evidence.

priority_bands.title: First manufacturer-grade drawing: K01-D-006 / P007
priority_bands.policy: P007 is the exemplar because it contains thin wall, weld/containment, locating GD&T and inspection complexity. Author PMI in the model first; drawing tolerances are derived only.

priority_bands.title: Parts registry + computed EBOM
priority_bands.policy: CAD owns structure/quantity. parts.json owns metadata. Custom properties are a one-way projection from registry. Non-modeled and suppressed items are explicit.

priority_bands.title: Remaining drawings + manufacturing BOM
priority_bands.policy: After P007/template feedback, batch drawing skeletons and close MBOM transformations including P007 welded construction.

priority_bands.title: Release-critical product requirements
priority_bands.policy: These remain production-release blockers even when CAD/FEA/drawings are green.

priority_bands.title: Magnetic quantitative acceptance
priority_bands.policy: Current field/automation screen is retained. Final force/bench evidence is reopened for actuator release.

priority_bands.title: Independent solver assurance
priority_bands.policy: DEFERRED_ASSURANCE. Reopen only if structural geometry/load/contact assumptions change materially, margin collapses, or release policy explicitly requires independent solver reconciliation.
